info.title: The Dive Bell
info.description: Live dive-conditions readings for fifteen coastlines (bells). Each bell's dawn and dusk windows are scored 1-10 for the week ahead, three times a day. A bell rings (gate=true) only when the water is perfect. Readings are true as of `updated` and replaced within hours. To be texted when a bell rings, a diver texts the bell's word (join.word) to join.number.

get.summary: Every bell's current reading: the week ahead, scored, with the best coves and any NWS hazard.

zones.description: Keyed by bell letter (A = Laguna Beach, D = La Jolla, E = Monterey, J = Oahu North Shore, K = Kona, O = Sydney, P = Maui ...).

tz.description: IANA time zone of the water.

season_note.description: When this bell usually rings, in words.

forecast_sms.description: The week ahead in four lines: the best window, every day scored, the bell's verdict.

join.description: How a diver joins this bell.

score.description: 1-10, relative to this bell's own water. 7+ is worth the drive.

limit.description: What holds the score back: swell, wind, stirred up, grey, rain, big tide, or all clear.

entries.description: This bell's best coves for this window.

gate.description: True only when the bell is ringing for this window.

hazard.description: A National Weather Service product in force during the window, e.g. Beach Hazards Statement. The bell never rings under one.
